content.about: Honduras is in Central America, with mountains, forests and a Caribbean coast. Its Bay Islands have coral reefs. Copán has Maya ruins. Whale sharks visit its waters.

standout.text: Copán is famous for having some of the finest carved Maya sculptures.

didYouKnow: The Bay Islands are on the Mesoamerican Reef.
Copán's hieroglyphic stairway is very long.
